description: This file contains the implementation of a platform service for reading General Ledger (GL) closure data, including methods for retrieving all closings for an office and fetching a specific closure by ID. It utilizes JDBC templates and maps SQL query results to data objects.

classes.name: GLClosureReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of GLClosureReadPlatformService, providing methods to retrieve GL closure data from the database.

classes.name: GLClosureMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation that maps SQL result set rows to GLClosureData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllGLClosures
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all GL closures, optionally filtered by office ID and ordered by closing date descending.

methods.name: retrieveGLClosureById
methods.description: Fetches a specific GL closure record by ID, throws exception if not found.
